messages:
Maya: Quick note 1 customer asked for a Console workflow to 'investigate spend' end-to-end: table of estimated spend + one-click jump to traces and logs. They want minimal SDK churn.
Liam: For clarity: estimate vs invoice accuracy?
Maya: They said "good enough to triage" not legal billing.
Priya: Implementation: attach span tags `tenant_id_hash`, `route`, `model_variant`, and `est_cost_usd`. Emit a short event to telemetry pipeline per request for export.
Noah: Sampling: keep global low rate. Add dynamic sampler: if `est_cost_usd` > threshold OR tenant in beta list => sample 100%. Also add opt-out flag per tenant.
Dina: UI ask: "Top estimated spenders" table, pivot by model/route, timepicker, row actions: "Open trace", "Export rows" (disabled by default). Tooltip: "Estimate computed at request time".
Zoe: UX: show mini-metrics for selected tenant: est_spend_7d, p99_latency, error_rate. Clicking "Open trace" opens trace viewer and highlights spans with `est_cost_usd`.
Sam: Ops: need feature flag + audit log for exports. Also a reconciliation job to compare est vs bill each window, alert if delta > 20% for top N tenants.
Liam: Proposal for export schema: `event_ts, tenant_hash, model, route, tokens, est_cost_usd, trace_id, batch_id`. I'll own versions.
Priya: SDK surface: optional `obs` param on requests. Backcompat: if absent we infer model+route from request metadata. Snippet:
```
client.request(..., obs={"model":"rwd-2b","route":"/v1/chat"})
span.set_tag('est_cost_usd', 0.0094)
```
Maya: Acceptance criteria for internal canary: 1) Console table + pivoting, 2) trace linkouts highlight cost spans, 3) export opt-in works for signed tenants, 4) docs + runbook.
Noah: Infra estimate: 1 week for sampling + retention caps. Backend: 2w for collection+export. UI: 1.5w. SDKs: small patches per language.
Dina: Legal: exports disabled by default; opt-in after agreement. I'll own legal checklist.
Zoe: Success metrics: median est vs invoice delta < 20% for top 50; time-to-detect expensive regression in canary down >40%; dashboard query median <250ms.
Maya: Owners: Liam=schema/export, Priya=SDK+collector, Noah=ingestion+sampling, Zoe=UX, Dina=legal, Maya=PM. I'll schedule a 30m to land epics.
obs-bot: Created OBS-900 "Spend investigation workflow" assigned to Maya, Priya, Liam, Noah, Dina, Zoe.
